name: CI

# Triggers are deliberately narrow: a push to `main`, a `v*` release tag, or
# an explicit manual dispatch. CI does not run on other branches and does not run on
# `pull_request`. This repository takes direct pushes to `main` from many
# worktrees and agent sessions; running the full matrix on every intermediate
# branch push spent runner capacity on refs nothing gates on. Branch protection
# is not applied here (see docs/CI-REQUIRED-CHECKS-V1.md), so no required check
# depended on the `pull_request` trigger. Use `workflow_dispatch` to check a
# branch before merging it.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # CI is a latest-ref health signal. A newer push or manual dispatch on the
  # same ref makes the older run stale, so stop it instead of spending runner
  # minutes finishing a matrix whose result will immediately be superseded.
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  agent-proposal-clients:
    name: AGENT-06 lifecycle and clients (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.part }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-15, windows-2025]
        # `lifecycle` runs the generated clients and the bounded --lib checks;
        # `revisions` runs the agent_runtime_v1 execution-revision corpus. The
        # two halves were one job that reached the six-hour ceiling.
        part: [lifecycle, revisions]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL: "1"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "1"
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR: target/agent-proposal-clients
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Keep the Windows checkout itself from failing on retained evidence paths.
          # The guard stays inside the step so workflow contracts that count
          # Windows-gated steps are unaffected.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Provision locked dependencies
        run: |
          cargo fetch --locked
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
      - name: Compile and execute every generated client
        if: matrix.part == 'lifecycle'
        run: python scripts/agent-proposal-clients.py
      - name: Check bounded iterative lifecycle and retained Copy records
        if: matrix.part == 'lifecycle'
        run: |
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --lib agent_lifecycle::iterative::
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --lib agent_runtime_v2::checkpoint::tests
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --lib execution_revision::typed::migration
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --lib retained_copy_record_calls_return_exact_fields_and_reject_forged_values
      - name: Check retained Project and iterative runtime root association
        if: runner.os != 'Windows' && matrix.part == 'revisions'
        run: |
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --test agent_runtime_v1 execution_revision::
      - name: Check typed execution revisions on Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.part == 'revisions'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $clang = (Get-Command clang.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          "SEMAPRAX_TEST_NATIVE_STAGE_CLANG=$clang" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          "SEMAPRAX_TEST_WASM_STAGE_NODE=$node" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          $env:SEMAPRAX_TEST_NATIVE_STAGE_CLANG = $clang
          $env:SEMAPRAX_TEST_WASM_STAGE_NODE = $node
          $env:LINK = '/STACK:8388608'
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --all-features --test agent_runtime_v1 execution_revision::typed:: -- --test-threads=2

  gen05b-generic-instance-closure:
    name: GEN-05B generic instance semantic closure
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # The exact inference and owned-result backend corpus exceeded 90 minutes
    # on the v0.6.0 hosted runner; keep every check and allow its full run.

    env:

          python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py checked --label GEN-05B -p semaprax --test project --exact generic_owned_dependency_runtime::dependency_internal_generic_owned_record_executes_without_public_generic_abi --nocapture
          python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py checked --label GEN-05B -p semaprax --test project --exact generic_owned_dependency_runtime::generic_owned_dependency_subject_tamper_is_rejected_before_callback --nocapture
          python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py checked --label GEN-05B -p semaprax --test ir --exact graph_generic_instances::graph_v34_deep_admitted_instance_does_not_depend_on_json_parser_recursion --nocapture

          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test workspace canonical_revision::generic_instances::generic_result_program_root_replays_checked_variant_closures -- --exact

  public-generic-ownership-milestone:
    name: Public generic ownership milestone (${{ matrix.os }})

    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master

      - name: Install the repository-pinned TypeScript compiler (Unix)

          echo "AR=$ar_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          clang --version

          for /f "tokens=*" %%i in ('where llvm-ar.exe') do if not defined AR set "AR=%%i"

          echo CC=%CC%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo CXX=%CXX%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo AR=%AR%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"

          call "%SPX_PG_TSC%" --version || exit /b 1
      - name: Install the generated Rust consumer's declared MSRV toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Issue #226: the crate `public_generic_consumer::rust_calling`
          # generator declares `rust-version = "1.88"` in its own Cargo.toml
          # (`public_generic_consumer::rust_calling::RUST_VERSION`). This
          # job's own build/test run on this job's toolchain above
          # (1.97.1), which proves the generated crate compiles on SOME
          # newer host toolchain, never on its declared minimum. Installing
          # 1.88 here, alongside rather than instead of 1.97.1, is what lets
          # `rust_calling_consumer.rs`'s
          # `generated_rust_calling_consumer_builds_and_runs_on_the_declared_msrv_toolchain`
          # resolve it through `rustup which cargo --toolchain 1.88` and
          # actually build and run the generated crate on it. Hard-fail
          # rather than report absence and continue, matching the C/C++
          # toolchain requirement above: a missing MSRV toolchain proves
          # nothing about the 1.88 claim, so it must never read as a pass.
          rustup toolchain install "1.88" --profile minimal --no-self-update
          rustup which cargo --toolchain "1.88"
      - name: Fetch locked workspace dependencies
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Grammar, template identities and compatibility rules
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib public_generic_type
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib public_generic_surface
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib public_generic_consumer
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib public_generic_settlement
      - name: Separation from internal generic semantics
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test project nested_owned_record_api::frozen_v11_descriptor_rejects_an_admitted_concrete_generic_result -- --exact
      - name: Four-language metadata consumers and hostile replay
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test projections public_generic_consumers -- --nocapture
      - name: Public generic ABI carrier, settlement corpus and WIT projection
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # `public_generic_abi` is the library module that owns the descriptor
          # carrier, the cross-engine settlement corpus and its pinned
          # settlement manifest, and the WIT projection. Until now no workflow
          # file selected it on any host: `--lib public_generic_settlement`
          # above is a different module, and the `--test` harnesses below drive
          # the adapters rather than this one. Every one of these cases passed
          # only on a contributor's own machine, which is exactly the "local
          # evidence described as hosted" gap issue #163 exists to close.
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib public_generic_abi
      - name: Callable-boundary corpus, generated consumers, settlement and hostile replay
        id: generic_callable_corpus
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # The step above runs the four-language *metadata* consumers, which
          # never call a compiled provider. These three harnesses do, and none
          # of them was selected by any workflow file until now -- real tests
          # that passed locally and were proven by no hosted run.
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test public_generic_native_adapter_v1
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test public_generic_wasm_adapter_v1
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test projections public_generic_descriptor_carrier_hostile_replay

      - name: Capture bounded generated Rust bytes after callable corpus failure
        if: failure() && steps.generic_callable_corpus.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test public_generic_native_adapter_v1 \
            authenticated_handoff::same_subject::profile_rust::generated_profile_byte_audit \
            -- --exact --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Native settlement sanitizer evidence and independent replay
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/public_generic_settlement_evidence.py --sanitizers --stress --output target/pg-settlement
          python3 scripts/public_generic_settlement_evidence.py --sanitizers --stress \
            --replay target/pg-settlement/evidence.json \
            --replay-lifecycle target/pg-settlement/native-lifecycle-evidence.json \
            --replay-result-phases target/pg-settlement/native-result-phase-evidence.json
          python3 scripts/public_generic_consumer_settlement.py --sanitizers --output target/pg-consumers
          python3 scripts/public_generic_consumer_settlement.py --sanitizers --output target/pg-consumers-replay \
            --replay target/pg-consumers/consumer-settlement.json
          python3 scripts/public_generic_consumer_mutations.py
          # Refusal of unsafe thread/reentrant use, not concurrent runtime support.
          python3 scripts/public_generic_settlement_threads.py --sanitizers --output target/pg-thread-admission
          python3 scripts/public_generic_settlement_threads.py --sanitizers \
            --replay target/pg-thread-admission/native-thread-admission-evidence.json
          python3 scripts/public_generic_settlement_thread_mutations.py
          # Host-owned TypeScript reference caller; NOT the missing compiled
          # Wasm provider ABI. The preceding Cargo test compares actual generated
          # assets before execution; this step adds fresh native semantic equality.
          python3 scripts/public_generic_typescript_settlement.py --native --output target/pg-typescript
          python3 scripts/public_generic_typescript_settlement.py --native --output target/pg-typescript-replay \
            --replay target/pg-typescript/typescript-settlement.json
          python3 scripts/public_generic_typescript_mutations.py

      - name: Compiled C11-reference provider inside Core Wasm (not public generic admission)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # A freestanding module with no WASI or allocator imports. The native
          # reference renderer remains the owner; no public profile is widened.
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lld
          command -v wasm-ld
          wasm-ld --version
          "${CLANG:-clang}" --version
          python3 scripts/public_generic_compiled_wasm.py --sanitizers --stress --output target/pg-compiled-reference
          python3 scripts/public_generic_compiled_wasm.py --sanitizers --stress \
            --replay target/pg-compiled-reference/compiled-reference-evidence.json
          python3 scripts/public_generic_compiled_wasm_mutations.py
          # Not implied by executing locally assembled template bytes: invoke
          # the real Rust renderer and require exact bytes before compiling.
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test public_generic_wasm_adapter_v1 \
            compiled_provider::actual_native_renderer_executes_in_core_wasm -- --ignored --exact

          # resolves `git rev-list -n1 v<version>` to compare README's
          # published-tag claim against the tag's actual commit. Under the
          # shallow, tagless checkout the other jobs use, that lookup finds
          # nothing and the script reports a false `inconsistent`.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: true
          lfs: false
      - name: Reconcile the documented release claim against local tag evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Offline and read-only: no network call, no file or Release is
          # mutated. Exits 0 for `no-candidate` and `tagged-unpublished`,
          # which are legitimate mid-release-prep states, and nonzero only
          # on real drift -- the class of defect bd777928 found by hand,
          # where README cited v0.4.0's commit for a v0.4.1 claim.
          python3 scripts/release-reconcile.py

    # Quoted: an unquoted `#` after a space starts a YAML comment, which
    # silently truncated this job's predecessor name at `(issue `.
    name: "Lean proof and obligation-export kernel gate (issues #186, #188)"
    # Hosted, and a release blocker. Both Lean artifacts are re-checked here
    # by the pinned kernel itself, not merely by their toolchain-free source
    # scans: `proofs/kernel0-lean/Kernel0.lean` (issue #188) is rebuilt cold
    # and its `#print axioms` sets re-audited, and the generated obligation
    # export under `src/proof_export` (issue #186) is fed to the same kernel
    # with a seeded `sorry` that must be refused.
    #
    # On AGENTS.md's "no build-time network access": provisioning a pinned
    # toolchain in a setup step is the same act this workflow already
    # performs for Rust (`rustup toolchain install "1.88"`), Node
    # (`actions/setup-node`) and TypeScript (`npm install -g
    # typescript@5.8.3`). What the invariant forbids is a *build* reaching
    # the network, and no build here does:
    # `proofs/kernel0-lean/lake-manifest.json` declares `"packages": []`, so
    # `lake build` resolves no dependency and contacts nothing. The elan
    # archive is pinned by release tag and checked against a recorded sha256
    # before it is unpacked; an unpinned `curl | sh` installer would not be
    # admissible here.
    #
    # Both gates run with `--require-kernel`, which converts their
    # skip-when-absent path into a hard failure. Without it, a provisioning
    # regression would leave this job green while checking nothing -- a
    # skipped kernel reported as a pass is exactly the false green that kept
    # this evidence local until now, and it is the reason the flag exists.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # The two v0.6.0 tag runs reached 120 and 240 minutes respectively while
    # the same complete differential selector was still running. Keep every
    # selector and sample intact, compile tests at modest optimization, and
    # bound the lane at the hosted runner's six-hour job limit.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL: "1"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "1"
      # Pinned by tag *and* by content digest. The tag alone is mutable.
      ELAN_RELEASE: v4.2.4
      ELAN_SHA256: 42b94d4244e8353142c456ec0e4ca6528fd898a6c604d4059f494e706e431f63
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Provision the pinned Lean toolchain
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # `proofs/kernel0-lean/lean-toolchain` is the single source of the
          # Lean pin: this step, `scripts/lean-export-gate.py`, and
          # `proof_export`'s own PINNED_TOOLCHAIN constant all read it, so a
          # toolchain bump cannot land in one place and not the others.
          toolchain="$(cat proofs/kernel0-lean/lean-toolchain)"
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/elan.tar.gz"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error \
            --location --output "$archive" \
            "https://github.com/leanprover/elan/releases/download/$ELAN_RELEASE/elan-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
          echo "$ELAN_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/elan-unpack"
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/elan-unpack"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/elan-unpack/elan-init" -y --no-modify-path \
            --default-toolchain "$toolchain"
          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Confirm the provisioned kernel is the pinned one
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Fail here, loudly, rather than let either gate discover a version
          # mismatch and describe it in its own words. The gates check this
          # too; a provisioning step that silently installed something else
          # should not reach them.
          want="$(cut -d: -f2 proofs/kernel0-lean/lean-toolchain)"
          lean --version
          lake --version
          lean --version | grep -F "${want#v}"
      - name: "Re-check the Kernel-0 Lean proof, build and axiom audit included (issue #188)"
        run: python3 scripts/kernel0-lean-gate.py --require-kernel
      - name: "Re-check the generated obligation export against the pinned kernel (issue #186)"
        run: python3 scripts/lean-export-gate.py --require-kernel
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - name: "Run the Kernel-0 cross-backend differential corpus for real (issue #188)"
        env:
          # Without this the lane gates itself on a local clang/node and
          # skips quietly. Nothing set it on any workflow, so since it
          # landed it had never run on a runner while its step still
          # reported success -- a lane that passes by returning early is
          # the same blackout as no CI selector at all. ubuntu-24.04 ships
          # both tools, so demanding the real run costs nothing but time.
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_KERNEL_ZERO_CROSS_BACKEND: "1"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          clang --version
          node --version
          cargo test --locked -p semaprax --lib kernel_zero::differential -- --nocapture

  wasm-scalar-exports-browser-v1:
    name: Public Wasm Scalar Exports v1 Chromium
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 240
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.88"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Build direct-source, baseline Project, and renamed Project calculators into isolated fixtures
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          fixture="$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-wasm-scalar-browser-v1"
          direct="$fixture/direct-source"
          project="$fixture/project-baseline"
          renamed="$fixture/project-renamed"
          renamed_project="$fixture/calculator-project-renamed"
          mkdir -p "$direct" "$project" "$renamed"
          cp -a examples/calculator-web/. "$direct/"
          cp -a examples/calculator-web/. "$project/"
          cp -a examples/calculator-web/. "$renamed/"
          cp -a examples/calculator-project "$renamed_project"
          sed -i 's/^fn add(/fn sum(/' "$renamed_project/src/core.spx"
          grep -Fqx 'fn sum(left: i64, right: i64) -> i64' "$renamed_project/src/core.spx"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build examples/calculator.spx --target web \
            --export calculator.add \
            --export calculator.subtract \
            --export calculator.multiply \
            --export calculator.divide \
            --export calculator.is-negative \
            --export calculator.not \
            -o "$direct/generated"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build \
            examples/calculator-project/semaprax.toml --target web \
            -o "$project/generated"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build \
            "$renamed_project/semaprax.toml" --target web \
            -o "$renamed/generated"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_DIRECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT=$direct" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT=$project" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_RENAMED_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT=$renamed" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Capture exact Project graph records for fixture pin diagnostics
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/wasm-scalar-project-graphs"
          mkdir "$evidence"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- graph examples/calculator-project/semaprax.toml > "$evidence/calculator-baseline.json"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- graph "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-wasm-scalar-browser-v1/calculator-project-renamed/semaprax.toml" > "$evidence/calculator-renamed.json"
          python3 - "$evidence" <<'PY'
          import base64, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          directory = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["cargo", "metadata", "--offline", "--locked", "--no-deps", "--format-version", "1"], text=True))
          binary = pathlib.Path(metadata["target_directory"]) / "debug" / "semaprax"
          digest = hashlib.sha256()
          with binary.open("rb") as source:
              for block in iter(lambda: source.read(65536), b""):
                  digest.update(block)
          record = {"head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(), "rustc": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version", "--verbose"], text=True), "binary_sha256": digest.hexdigest()}
          (directory / "provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
          files = {}
          for name in ("calculator-baseline.json", "calculator-renamed.json", "provenance.json"):
              payload = (directory / name).read_bytes()
              files[name] = {"bytes": len(payload), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), "base64": base64.b64encode(payload).decode("ascii")}
          print("SEMAPRAX_PROJECT_GRAPH_EVIDENCE_V1 " + json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True))
          PY
      - name: Install the locked Playwright fixture and Chromium
        working-directory: platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          npx --no-install playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Type-check all three real generated declaration consumers
        working-directory: platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsc --strict --noEmit --target ES2022 \
            --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext \
            "$SEMAPRAX_DIRECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT/consumer.ts"
          npx --no-install tsc --strict --noEmit --target ES2022 \
            --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext \
            "$SEMAPRAX_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT/consumer.ts"
          npx --no-install tsc --strict --noEmit --target ES2022 \
            --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext \
            "$SEMAPRAX_RENAMED_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT/consumer.ts"
      - name: Exercise all three generated calculators in serial real Chromium workers
        working-directory: platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
        run: >-
          npm run test:fixtures --
          "$SEMAPRAX_DIRECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT"
          "$SEMAPRAX_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT"
          "$SEMAPRAX_RENAMED_PROJECT_CALCULATOR_ROOT"
      - name: Build the Project v13 HTTPS package into an isolated fixture
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          https_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-https-browser-v1"
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build \
            examples/https-project/semaprax.toml --target npm \
            -o "$https_root"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_HTTPS_PACKAGE_ROOT=$https_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install the locked HTTPS browser fixture
        working-directory: platform-tests/https-browser-v1
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Exercise generated fixture-backed HTTPS in real Chromium
        working-directory: platform-tests/https-browser-v1
        run: npm test

  project-product-acceptance-v1:
    name: Project Product Acceptance v1 (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-15, windows-2025]
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.88"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install the repository-pinned TypeScript compiler (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          tsc_path="$(pwd)/node_modules/.bin/tsc"
          test -x "$tsc_path"
          test "$($tsc_path --version)" = "Version 5.8.3"
          echo "TSC=$tsc_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install the repository-pinned TypeScript compiler (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: cmd
        working-directory: platform-tests/wasm-scalar-browser-v1
        run: |
          call npm ci --ignore-scripts
          if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
          if not exist "%CD%\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd" exit /b 1
          for /f "tokens=*" %%i in ('call "%CD%\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd" --version') do set "TSC_VERSION=%%i"
          if not "%TSC_VERSION%"=="Version 5.8.3" exit /b 1
          echo TSC=%CD%\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
      - name: Resolve exact held native tools (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustc_path="$(rustup which rustc)"
          clang_path="$(command -v clang)"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            # The held builder uses the Command Line Tools SDK explicitly.
            # Select that installation's driver and companion linker together.
            clang_path=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/clang
            test -x "$clang_path"
            test -d /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
            export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools
            export SDKROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
            echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=$DEVELOPER_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "SDKROOT=$SDKROOT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Linux" ]]; then
            clang_path="$(readlink -f "$clang_path")"
          fi
          test -x "$rustc_path"
          test -x "$clang_path"
          echo "RUSTC=$rustc_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CLANG=$clang_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            archiver_path=/usr/bin/libtool
          else
            archiver_path="$(readlink -f /usr/bin/ar)"
          fi
          test -x "$archiver_path"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=$archiver_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Resolve exact held native tools and MSVC environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath`) do set "VSINSTALL=%%i"
          if not defined VSINSTALL exit /b 1
          call "%VSINSTALL%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -no_logo -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64
          if not defined VCToolsInstallDir exit /b 1
          set "SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%VCToolsInstallDir%"
          if "%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS:~-1%"=="\" set "SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS:~0,-1%"
          set "SEMAPRAX_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%\bin\Hostx64\x64\link.exe"
          set "SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%\bin\Hostx64\x64\lib.exe"
          if not exist "%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%" exit /b 1
          if not exist "%SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER%" exit /b 1
          for /f "tokens=*" %%i in ('rustup which rustc') do set "RUSTC=%%i"
          for /f "tokens=*" %%i in ('where clang.exe') do if not defined CLANG set "CLANG=%%i"
          if not defined RUSTC exit /b 1
          if not defined CLANG exit /b 1
          echo INCLUDE=%INCLUDE%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo LIB=%LIB%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo RUSTC=%RUSTC%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo CLANG=%CLANG%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=%SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_MSVC_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo LINK=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo _LINK_=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
      - name: Fetch the root workspace and standalone Rust consumer dependency closures
        run: |
          cargo fetch --locked
          cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/calculator-rust/Cargo.toml
      - name: Require exact reproducible Darwin archive admission
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_DARWIN_REAL_ARCHIVE: "1"
        run: cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax-native-rust-interop-platform-sys --lib tests::archive_admission::darwin_real_d_archive_is_exact_and_reproducible_across_tool_versions -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
      - name: Freeze the focused acceptance workflow contract
        run: cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --test project_product_acceptance_ci_contract -- --nocapture
      - name: Require the complete project, daemon, Web, native, Wasm, TypeScript, and Rust cycle
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_PROJECT_TYPESCRIPT: "1"
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_PROJECT_NATIVE_RUST_SDK: "1"
        run: cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --test project_product_acceptance_v1 -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture

  verify-build:
    name: Rust build ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      # Keep the test compiler inside the cache host's 256-MiB executable bound
      # and avoid linking debug symbols into every integration-test binary.
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Resolve the real held rustc image (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: echo "RUSTC=$(rustup which rustc)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Resolve the held Clang and deterministic archiver images (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          clang_path="$(command -v clang)"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            # The held builder uses the Command Line Tools SDK explicitly.
            # Select that installation's driver and companion linker together.
            clang_path=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/clang
            test -x "$clang_path"
            test -d /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
            export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools
            export SDKROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
            echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=$DEVELOPER_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "SDKROOT=$SDKROOT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Linux" ]]; then
            clang_path="$(readlink -f "$clang_path")"
          fi
          test -x "$clang_path"
          echo "CLANG=$clang_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            archiver_path=/usr/bin/libtool
          else
            archiver_path="$(readlink -f /usr/bin/ar)"
          fi
          test -x "$archiver_path"
          echo "SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=$archiver_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Resolve the real held rustc image (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          "RUSTC=$(rustup which rustc)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Keep Windows compiler and test artifacts compact
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          "CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          "CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          "CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Resolve the authenticated Windows SDK and MSVC environment
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath`) do set "VSINSTALL=%%i"
          if not defined VSINSTALL exit /b 1
          call "%VSINSTALL%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -no_logo -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64
          if not defined VCToolsInstallDir exit /b 1
          set "SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%VCToolsInstallDir%"
          if "%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS:~-1%"=="\" set "SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS:~0,-1%"
          set "SEMAPRAX_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%\bin\Hostx64\x64\link.exe"
          set "SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%\bin\Hostx64\x64\lib.exe"
          if not exist "%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%" exit /b 1
          if not exist "%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%" exit /b 1
          if not exist "%SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER%" exit /b 1
          echo INCLUDE=%INCLUDE%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo LIB=%LIB%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS=%SEMAPRAX_VCTOOLS%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=%SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_MSVC_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo LINK=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo _LINK_=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
      - name: Resolve the held Clang image (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $clang = (Get-Command clang.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($clang)) { throw "clang path is not absolute" }
          "CLANG=$clang" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Provision the native HTTPS development interface (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libcurl4-openssl-dev
      - name: Fetch the complete locked workspace dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch the standalone owned-data Rust setup dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/owned-data-rust/Cargo.toml
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          exclude=()
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then exclude=(--exclude semaprax-harness); fi
          cargo clippy --locked --workspace "${exclude[@]}" --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          exclude=()
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then exclude=(--exclude semaprax-harness); fi
          cargo test --locked --workspace "${exclude[@]}" --all-features --doc
      - name: Execute every benchmark target in the full test profile
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        # The unit/integration shard planner deliberately leaves benches here.
        # Use cargo test: cargo bench adds --bench to custom harness arguments.
        run: cargo test --locked --workspace --all-features --bench '*'
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          exclude=()
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then exclude=(--exclude semaprax-harness); fi
          cargo doc --locked --workspace "${exclude[@]}" --all-features --no-deps
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          exclude=()
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then exclude=(--exclude semaprax-harness); fi
          cargo build --locked --workspace "${exclude[@]}" --release
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/meaning.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/ownership.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/lifecycle.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/control_flow.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/records.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check examples/native_callable.spx
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/meaning.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/effects.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/ownership.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/lifecycle.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/control_flow.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/records.spx --check
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt examples/native_callable.spx --check
      - name: Check and format the remaining full-profile examples
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for source in chars integers_i32 bytes_u8 explicit_mutation string_ops field_mutation while_loops inheritance calculator-rust/callback; do
            cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- check "examples/$source.spx"
            cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- fmt "examples/$source.spx" --check
          done
      - name: Build public native-callable bundle
        run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build examples/native_callable.spx --target native-callable --function example.token.identity -o target/native-callable-example
      - name: Build and run native example (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build examples/control_flow.spx -o target/control-flow
          test "$(target/control-flow)" = "42"
      - name: Build and run native example (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build examples/control_flow.spx -o target/control-flow.exe
          $result = & target/control-flow.exe
          if ($result -ne "42") { throw "expected 42, received $result" }
      - run: cargo run --locked -p semaprax -- build examples/control_flow.spx --target web -o target/control-flow-web
      - run: node scripts/verify-web.mjs target/control-flow-web
      - name: Verify publishable crate
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo package --locked -p semaprax

      - name: Resolve the held Clang image (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $clang = (Get-Command clang.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($clang)) { throw "clang path is not absolute" }
          "CLANG=$clang" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Provision the native HTTPS development interface (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libcurl4-openssl-dev
      - name: Fetch the complete locked workspace dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch the standalone owned-data Rust setup dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/owned-data-rust/Cargo.toml
      - name: Fetch standalone lockfile-check dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          plan_args=(--plan-only)
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then
            plan_args+=(--exclude-package semaprax-native-rust-interop --exclude-package semaprax-harness)
          fi
          plan_json="$(python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py "${plan_args[@]}")"
          if python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); s=next((x for x in p["shards"] if x["name"]==sys.argv[1]), {"targets":[]}); sys.exit(0 if any(t["name"]=="standalone_lockfiles" for t in s["targets"]) else 1)' '${{ matrix.shard }}' <<<"$plan_json"; then
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/calculator-rust/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/embedding-api/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path crates/semaprax-native-rust-interop-builder/src/public_sdk/fixtures/ri09-reqwest/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path platform-tests/component-runtime/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path platform-tests/public-scalar-wit-interface/Cargo.toml
          fi
          # The shard planner moves test targets between shards as the suite
          # grows, so the static reference service is built for whichever
          # shard actually runs semaprax-native-host's runtime_host target.
          if python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); s=next((x for x in p["shards"] if x["name"]==sys.argv[1]), {"targets":[]}); sys.exit(0 if any(t["name"]=="runtime_host" for t in s["targets"]) else 1)' '${{ matrix.shard }}' <<<"$plan_json"; then
            echo "SEMAPRAX_SHARD_RUNS_REFERENCE_SERVICE=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
      - name: Build the static Linux reference service for its packaging acceptance
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.SEMAPRAX_SHARD_RUNS_REFERENCE_SERVICE == '1'
        shell: bash
        env:
          CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_musl: musl-gcc
          CARGO_NET_OFFLINE: "true"
          RUSTFLAGS: -C relocation-model=static
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends musl-tools
          rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          cargo build --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl \
            -p semaprax-native-host --bin semaprax-reference-service
          executable="$PWD/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/debug/semaprax-reference-service"
          test -x "$executable"
          readelf -h "$executable" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*Type:[[:space:]]+EXEC[[:space:]]+'
          if readelf -l "$executable" | grep -q INTERP; then
            echo 'reference service unexpectedly has a dynamic interpreter' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SEMAPRAX_TEST_REFERENCE_SERVICE_STATIC_EXECUTABLE=$executable" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        id: workspace_target_shard_unix
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_KERNEL_ZERO_RUNG_TWO_TARGETS: "1"

        run: python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py --label "Rust $RUNNER_OS" --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}" --nocapture
      - name: Preserve the exact macOS unit executable for bounded replay
        id: macos_unit_replay
        if: always() && runner.os == 'macOS' && matrix.shard == 'unit' && steps.workspace_target_shard_unix.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        run: python3 scripts/ci-unit-artifact.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-unit-replay"
      - name: Upload the current macOS unit replay artifact

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: semaprax-unit-macos-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/semaprax-unit-replay
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Capture task-service frontend bytes after a failed owning shard
        if: failure() && runner.os != 'Windows' && matrix.shard == 'integration-0' && steps.workspace_target_shard_unix.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --all-features --test useful_data \
            task_service_project::task_service_frontend_byte_audit -- \
            --exact --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Test the complete workspace target shard without duplicate Windows native interop
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $split = @()
          if ('${{ matrix.shard }}' -eq 'integration-3') { $split = @('--split-windows-agent-runtime') }
          python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py --label "Rust Windows" --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}" --exclude-package semaprax-native-rust-interop --exclude-package semaprax-harness --nocapture @split

  release-artifacts:
    name: Release artifact (${{ matrix.target }})
    # `success()` is written explicitly rather than relied on implicitly: a
    # bare tag-prefix condition with no status function is still ANDed with
    # `success()` by GitHub today, but that insertion is undocumented
    # behaviour this workflow must not depend on silently. Say what is meant:
    # this job never runs unless `release-gate` -- the exact-tag blocking
    # gate -- has already succeeded in this same run.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-gate
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    # Each producer attests its own smoke-tested archive. The OIDC and
    # attestation capabilities are intentionally scoped here rather than
    # inherited by ordinary CI jobs or the aggregate release gate.
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Unix release artifact
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        run: scripts/package-release.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_SHA" "${{ matrix.target }}" dist
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Linux release artifact in the glibc 2.35 baseline container
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: scripts/package-release-linux-container.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_SHA" "${{ matrix.target }}" dist
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Windows release artifact
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: scripts/package-release.ps1 -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME -Commit $env:GITHUB_SHA -Target "${{ matrix.target }}" -OutputRoot dist
      - name: Run the archive product harness against the exact packaged archive
        shell: bash
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          package="semaprax-v$version-${{ matrix.target }}"
          unpacked="$RUNNER_TEMP/archive-product"
          mkdir "$unpacked"
          # Unpacked outside the checkout, from the archive bytes themselves.
          if [ "${{ matrix.extension }}" = zip ]; then
            python3 -m zipfile -e "dist/$package.zip" "$unpacked"
          else
            python3 -m tarfile -e "dist/$package.tar.gz" "$unpacked"
          fi
          SEMAPRAX_RELEASE_ROOT="$unpacked/$package" SEMAPRAX_RELEASE_COMMIT="$GITHUB_SHA" \
            cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test release_archive_product_v1 -- \
            --ignored provisioned_archive_cli_and_daemon_work_outside_checkout --exact --nocapture
      - name: Attest the exact smoke-tested target archive
        id: attest-release-archive
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: dist/semaprax-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}
      - name: Stage the exact target attestation bundle for release publication
        shell: bash
        env:
          ATTESTATION_BUNDLE: ${{ steps.attest-release-archive.outputs.bundle-path }}
          RELEASE_BUNDLE: dist/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE"
          test -f "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE"
          cp -- "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE" "$RELEASE_BUNDLE"
          test -s "$RELEASE_BUNDLE"
      - name: Retain the exact target archive for aggregate publication
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            dist/semaprax-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}
            dist/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          compression-level: 0

  release-candidate:
    name: Release candidate metadata
    # Assembles the exact SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json publication
    # will carry, from the exact archives the producers attested, so the
    # install journey below can consume candidate bytes through the
    # installers' normal download path before anything is public.
    # publish-release regenerates both and refuses to publish unless they
    # are byte-identical to these.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download every exercised target archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: release-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Assemble the candidate SHA256SUMS and release manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          archives=(
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
          )
          for archive in "${archives[@]}"; do
            test -f "dist/$archive"
          done
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 dist/
          (cd dist && sha256sum "${archives[@]}" install.sh install.ps1) > dist/SHA256SUMS
          python3 scripts/release-manifest.py \
            --version "$version" \
            --tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --archives-dir dist \
            --output dist/release-manifest.json
          mkdir candidate-metadata
          cp dist/SHA256SUMS dist/release-manifest.json candidate-metadata/
      - name: Retain the candidate metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate-metadata
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  release-install-journey:
    name: Release install journey (${{ matrix.target }}, ${{ matrix.shell }})
    # The distribution boundary: each target's exact attested archive goes
    # through the tagged installer's normal download path (file:// staging of
    # the candidate bytes), into a fresh user prefix whose path contains a
    # space, then the beginner journey, daemon handshake, reinstall, a
    # damaged-archive control and uninstall (docs/INSTALLER-V1.md). Linux runs
    # in a bare ubuntu:22.04 container: the declared glibc 2.35 baseline with
    # no Rust, Clang, Node or checkout toolchain on the execution path.
    # Publication requires every cell.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-candidate
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
            shell: powershell
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
            shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download this target's exact attested archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: candidate
      - name: Download the candidate metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate
      - name: Stage the tagged installers beside the candidate assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 candidate/
          ls -la candidate
          # A source-checkout binary must never stand in for the archive.
          test ! -e candidate/semaprax
      - name: Verify the target archive's publisher attestation
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh attestation verify "candidate/semaprax-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}" \
            --bundle "candidate/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json" \
            --repo wavect/semaprax \
            --signer-workflow wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml \
            --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
            --deny-self-hosted-runners
      - name: Linux journey in the glibc 2.35 baseline container
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run --rm -e GITHUB_REF_NAME \
            -v "$PWD/scripts/install-journey.sh:/journey.sh:ro" \
            -v "$PWD/candidate:/candidate:ro" \
            ubuntu:22.04 sh -c '
              set -eu
              apt-get update -qq >/dev/null
              apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates >/dev/null
              getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION
              cp -R /candidate /tmp/candidate
              sh /journey.sh /tmp/candidate "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
            '
      - name: macOS journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_REQUIRE_PUBLISHER: "1"
        run: sh scripts/install-journey.sh "$PWD/candidate" "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - name: Windows PowerShell 5.1 journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.shell == 'powershell'
        shell: powershell
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_PUBLISHER_VERIFY: "1"
        run: |
          & ./scripts/install-journey.ps1 -AssetsDir "$PWD\candidate" -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: PowerShell 7 journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.shell == 'pwsh'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_PUBLISHER_VERIFY: "1"
        run: |
          & ./scripts/install-journey.ps1 -AssetsDir "$PWD\candidate" -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

  publish-release:
    name: Publish tag release
    if: ${{ startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && success() }}

      id-token: write

      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths

          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download every exercised target archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: release-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Stage the tagged installers verbatim as release assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Published byte-identical to the tagged sources; the same bytes the
          # release-install-journey matrix already installed from.
          test ! -e dist/install.sh
          test ! -e dist/install.ps1
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 dist/
          cmp scripts/install.sh dist/install.sh
          cmp scripts/install.ps1 dist/install.ps1
      - name: Authenticate the complete archive inventory and produce SHA256SUMS
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          archives=(
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
          )
          attestations=(
            "release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json"
            "release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json"
            "release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json"
            "release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json"
            "release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json"
          )
          test "$(find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'semaprax-*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "${#archives[@]}"
          for archive in "${archives[@]}"; do
            test -f "dist/$archive"
          done
          test "$(find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'release-attestation-*.json' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "${#attestations[@]}"
          for attestation in "${attestations[@]}"; do
            test -s "dist/$attestation"
          done
          # Freeze the root before the first aggregate verification so every
          # archive/bundle pair is checked against the exact root published
          # with this release. `--bundle` prevents a different API-fetched
          # attestation from standing in for the retained one.
          test ! -e dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          gh attestation trusted-root \
            | head -c 4194305 > dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test "$(wc -c < dist/trusted_root.jsonl | tr -d ' ')" -le 4194304
          for index in "${!archives[@]}"; do
            archive="${archives[$index]}"
            attestation="${attestations[$index]}"
            gh attestation verify "dist/$archive" \
              --bundle "dist/$attestation" \
              --custom-trusted-root dist/trusted_root.jsonl \
              --repo wavect/semaprax \
              --signer-workflow wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml \
              --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
              --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done
          (cd dist && sha256sum "${archives[@]}" install.sh install.ps1) > dist/SHA256SUMS
          test "$(wc -l < dist/SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' ')" = "$(( ${#archives[@]} + 2 ))"
      - name: Generate the final release manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          python3 scripts/release-manifest.py \
            --version "$version" \
            --tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --archives-dir dist \
            --output dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
      - name: Download the candidate metadata the install journey consumed
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate
      - name: Confirm publication carries exactly the tested candidate metadata
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # release-install-journey installed every target from these exact
          # SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json bytes; publishing anything
          # else would publish untested metadata.
          cmp candidate/SHA256SUMS dist/SHA256SUMS
          cmp candidate/release-manifest.json dist/release-manifest.json
      - name: Generate release provenance from the final manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$tag" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          python3 scripts/release-provenance.py \
            --manifest dist/release-manifest.json \
            --workflow-identity "wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml@refs/tags/$tag" \
            --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --run-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            --rustc-version "$(rustc --version)" \
            --host-class github-hosted-ubuntu-24.04 \
            --output dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
      - name: Install pinned cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
        with:
          cosign-release: v3.1.3
      - name: Sign final release provenance with keyless Sigstore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          cosign sign-blob --yes \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
      - name: Derive the signature claim after archive-attestation verification
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
          test ! -e dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test "$(wc -c < dist/trusted_root.jsonl | tr -d ' ')" -le 4194304
          python3 scripts/release-signature-claim.py \
            --provenance dist/release-provenance.json \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            --output dist/release-signature-claim.json
          python3 scripts/release-signature-claim.py \
            --provenance dist/release-provenance.json \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            --check dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/release-signature-claim.json
      - name: Independently verify the signed release before publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          package="semaprax-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
          archive="dist/$package.tar.gz"
          test -s "$archive"
          test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          # Stream only the exact smoke-tested CLI member, never extract the
          # archive's remaining paths into the publisher filesystem.
          tar -xOzf "$archive" "$package/semaprax" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          chmod 0500 "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          root_digest="$(sha256sum dist/trusted_root.jsonl | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify" doctor verify-release dist \
            --trusted-root-sha256 "$root_digest"
      - name: Publish the release archives only after complete aggregation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          python3 scripts/release-notes.py --version "$version" --assets-dir dist > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
          test -s dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json
          # A superseded tag run must never replace the current release assets.
          test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME^{}" | cut -f1)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          assets=(
            dist/semaprax-* dist/SHA256SUMS
            dist/release-manifest.json dist/release-provenance.json
            dist/release-provenance.bundle dist/release-signature-claim.json
            dist/trusted_root.jsonl
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
            dist/release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
            dist/release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json
            dist/install.sh dist/install.ps1
          )
          if gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${assets[@]}" --clobber
            gh release edit "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease=false \
              --title "SEMAPRAX $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          else
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${assets[@]}" \
              --verify-tag \
              --title "SEMAPRAX $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          fi
      - name: Confirm the published download URLs resolve (read-only)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Bounded, read-only discoverability check; it never deletes or
          # edits a release. A failure here is reported for a human to act on.
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          base="https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/releases/download/$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          for asset in install.sh install.ps1 SHA256SUMS release-manifest.json \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"; do
            ok=0
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
              if curl -fsSIL --max-time 30 -o /dev/null "$base/$asset"; then ok=1; break; fi
              sleep 10
            done
            test "$ok" = 1 || { echo "published asset does not resolve: $asset" >&2; exit 1; }
          done
